MP3 Studio is a music player and studio for the songs on your phone, made by Autoom Studio, an AI automation and IT solutions company based in India.

MP3 Studio has no ads. Your music, playlists, stems and recordings stay on your phone and are never uploaded. Signing in stores your Google account name, email and photo on our servers, along with your plan and feature usage. The microphone is used only when you record a sing-along.
